I am getting older now at 62, so my family does most of the work, but I sometimes hire young men from the village for the heavy land preparation. I will use the fertilizer and hybrid seed I get through the government subsidy program because I have seen with my own eyes that maize yields are better than with local seed alone, and I will also spread cow manure on this plot because it keeps the soil healthy. We cannot afford pesticide or herbicide chemicals, and we have no way to irrigate, so we will weed by hand and depend on the rains like always. For this small quarter-hectare plot, my family will put in many days across the season, but I will need a few hired hands at the start to help with the digging.
